blurb: `trustFrom` names a variable that holds trust roots as JSON. A variable an actor uses as its `secret` holds a signing key, and one variable cannot be both. Give `trustFrom` a variable of its own.
example:
type UserId = String where NonEmpty
type WorkloadId = String where NonEmpty

actor User { auth = Bearer(secret = "JWT_KEY"), identity = UserId }
actor Workload { auth = Oidc(issuer = "https://i.test", audience = "a", jwks = "https://i.test/jwks", trustFrom = "JWT_KEY"), identity = WorkloadId }   // ✗ `JWT_KEY` is a key

actor Workload { auth = Oidc(issuer = "https://i.test", audience = "a", jwks = "https://i.test/jwks", trustFrom = "OIDC_TRUST"), identity = WorkloadId }   // ✓
summary: An `Oidc` actor's `trustFrom` names an environment variable that an actor uses as its `secret`.
